rows.grounds: Compound svacchanda (own-will, voluntary) + maraṇa (death); nominative form in sandhi-split surface, meaning death occurring by one's own will.
Absolutive of bhū (to be, become), indicating prior completed action.

Compound with prasaṃyuta (endowed-with, united-with); first member kulasāhat interpreted as related to kula (lineage/family) and sāha (power/strength), exact formation uncertain without broader passage context.
